Note this evidences DGI-administered taxes specifically; customs duties (a separate authority) are not confirmed as digitally payable, so 'other revenue' coverage is not fully evidenced. Score confirmed at 3=Yes.

Definition: Percentage of the adult population (15+ years) who have made at least one digital payment transaction through the instant payment system in the past 90 days, indicating active usage rather than just account ownership.
Comments: Gabon's Ministry of Economy reported 1.6 million active mobile money accounts at end-2024 (out of 4.5 million total accounts). With Gabon's population ~2.5m, this implies a majority of residents (and likely >50% of adults) are active users of mobile money/digital payments, supporting the 50–69% bracket.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed with a better-grounded source. The original figure relied on shaky account-vs-population arithmetic (multiple accounts per person make this unreliable). The World Bank Global Findex 2025 (compiled via FinStatGlobe) instead gives a direct adult-level metric: Digital Payment Adoption 66.5% and Mobile Money Account Ownership 61.6% for Gabon (2024), both within the 50-69% band. Note the Findex measure is 'in the past year' rather than the variable's specified 90-day window, so this remains an approximation. Score confirmed at 3=50-69%.
